oracle: GNU grep (see grep_version): -F fixed strings, -a so NUL bytes are ordinary data, LC_ALL=C so -i folds ASCII only. Traversal order for -r is computed from the contract rather than taken from grep -r, which follows raw readdir order. tests/reference_generators/grep_reference.py supplies only the cases listed under model_only_cases, which no real grep can produce. Neither is ever copied into a sandbox.
